text: Alumni Relations Officer Checklist Immediately Following Election:  Meet with outgoing Alumni Relations Officer to discuss transition  Call/Email Province Alumni Coordinator (if applicable) to introduce yourself  Call/Email local Area Alumni Associations (if applicable) to introduce yourself  Within 2 Weeks of Election:  Acquire Alumni List – Chapter/Area  Reach out to recent graduates to acquire updated contact/mailing information  Reach out to alumni to maintain accurate information  Weekly Tasks:  Send reminders to local alumni about chapter events  Submit officer report to the Secretary for the chapter meeting  Monthly Tasks:  Send invitations to local alumni about chapter events  Yearly Expectations:  Invite alumni to Chapter Day Ceremony  Invite alumni to attend or participate in Initiation Ritual  Invite alumni to attend or participate in American Music Recital  Invite alumni to participate in Mills Music Missions  Work with Chapter to present Membership Award Pins to 10, 25, & 50 Year Members  Work with Chapter to present The Christopher Patterson Veterans Challenge Coin Send out Alumni Newsletter  Plan and Coordinate Homecoming Alumni Event – Family Friendly  Invite Alumni to Founder’s Day Ceremony (October 6)  As Needed Expectations:  Report notice of deceased Brothers by submitting Final Chord Report (MySinfonia)  Notifying Chapters or Alumni Associations when alumni move to that area  Notify Lyrecrest of any changes in alumni contact information  Have Alumni fill out contact information update sheet upon arriving at events  Check on the member status of alumni attending chapter events  Assist alumni in accessing MySinfonia  Contact Lyrecrest if you come across a Brother who is not in the database
